messages:
ryan: quick thing — thinking about surfacing per-route SLO alerts in the console. right now we only show org-level SLOs and a global alert toggle. customers keep asking to mute noisy routes or get notified only for canaries.

katie: +1. can we let teams bind alerts to specific API keys or routes? e.g., prod vs canary vs internal-testing. also need a way to preview which tenants would fire if we change threshold. :eyes: 

lin: agree — two UX pieces: 1) a lightweight per-route alert editor in the Routing/Traffic page, 2) a preview modal that runs tenant-scope simulation and shows estimated fanout. preview should show estimated notifications per channel (email/pager/slack).

emma: from product side: constraints: no extra paging for SRE unless severity >= P1, and must expose noise suppression knobs (burst window, dedupe window, backoff). also want to tie alerts to rollout stages (only notify when canary breaches, not every tenant during canary).

joel: ops concern — preview needs to use historical telemetry (30d) and respect caching/kv differences. otherwise simulation will be misleading for bursty routes. also add cost-estimate for notifications (rough count) so sales/customer success can talk to customers.

sre-bot: deploy 1768304200 started: feature/alert-preview -> staging (auto-notify: off)

ryan: rough sketch of the per-route alert config we discussed:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "scope": "api_key:abcd-...",
  "slo": { "window": "7d", "target": 0.995 },
  "alert": {
    "threshold": "error_budget <= 0",
    "channels": ["email","slack"],
    "severity": "P2",
    "noise_suppression": { "dedupe_window_s": 300, "burst_threshold": 10, "backoff_factor": 2 }
  },
  "rollout_binding": { "stage": "canary", "notify_on": "only_canary" }
}
```

katie: love that. tiny ask: expose a toggle for "notify only if X% of tenants affected" (so a bad client doesn't spam alerts). default maybe 5%.

lin: implementation note: backend rule engine can evaluate on current aggregated metrics and also run a fast forward-scan against sampled per-tenant series for preview. for actual firing we should compute per-tenant boolean then aggregate using threshold percent. avoids paging for single-customer flakiness.

emma: UX: in the edit panel show 3 tabs: Conditions, Scope (routes/api-keys), Preview (list of affected tenants with sample traces). Add a small badge: "Estimated notifies: 12". Users can toggle "suppress duplicates within 5m".

joel: ops: we need a migration path for existing org-level alerts. maybe auto-create route-bound copies with same semantics, put in a new "legacy" group and surface a bulk-edit flow. plus a single-click "apply noise suppression" to all.

ryan: question for eng-sre: do we want the UI to allow editing raw rule JSON (advanced) or only guided form?

lin: guided form + "advanced JSON" toggle. advanced mode will show same JSON and validate against schema. validation tip: block rules that can fanout > 1k notifications by default unless user explicitly acknowledges.

katie: small thread: what about on-call routing? if severity == P1 -> page+slack, if P2 -> slack+email, allow per-team overrides. also allow a "silent" mode for canaries where it logs but does not notify.

emma: noted. I'll sketch wireframes. @ryan can you add the preview API endpoint (/v1/alerts/preview) to the spec? needs to accept rule JSON + time window and return estimated_tenant_hits and estimated_notifications_by_channel.

ryan: yep will add to spec. jira: PLAT-3987 to track. I'll add the sample schema and one e2e test.

joel: one more ops safety item: rate-limit notifications per-channel per-tenant to 1/min by default and allow org override. prevents spirals when many routes fail simultaneously.

lin: good call. also add a telemetry metric: alert_preview_runs and preview_error_rate so we can monitor misuse.

ryan: thanks all — i'll put a rough PR up to staging with the UI panel and preview endpoint. reviewers: @katie @lin @joel. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy 1768306600 completed: feature/alert-preview -> staging (tests: 182 passed, 3 flaky)

katie: saw the new panel in staging, looks promising. will post UX comments in the PR.

lin: logging one follow-up: ensure the preview respects private tenants (mask ids) and does not leak PII.

ryan: yes, preview will return aggregated counts and masked tenant ids by default. thanks.
